title: Signal: Shared static SimpleDateFormat (java)
scope: Single-line lexical match on static SimpleDateFormat fields in Java code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: flags a static SimpleDateFormat field regardless of whether it is ever shared across threads.

examples.line: private static final SimpleDateFormat FMT = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
# audit: private static final SimpleDateFormat FMT = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd"); present
private static final ThreadLocal<SimpleDateFormat> FMT = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd"));
# verified: private static final ThreadLocal<SimpleDateFormat> FMT = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd"));

fpNotes: Single-threaded tools and batch jobs are the common false positive.
